provenance.mnist: sklearn.datasets.fetch_openml('mnist_784', version=1) -- standard MNIST, 70000 x 784. No local cache was found on this PC (checked ~/.keras, ~/scikit_learn_data, torchvision caches, and filesystem search); fetched fresh.
provenance.shapes: Self-generated: 3 classes (square/circle/triangle), 1500 each, 20x20, ~12px shapes centered with +/-3px position jitter + 5% salt noise. 100% ours, no download.

shapes_note: Position regime matters and is reported honestly: at FIXED position the Mark I gets 100% (3-way); with the +/-3px jitter used here it stays high; under FREE placement anywhere on the 20x20 retina accuracy collapses to ~chance (~41% 3-way) because a single linear readout cannot be position-invariant -- the classic Minsky-Papert limitation. Rosenblatt's real demos operated in the modest-jitter regime, which is what we reproduce.
